recommendations.rationale: Retained but unread plans-view records (optimization_selected_iteration, optimization_raw_status) and saved projected states (measured_initial_state) are the cheapest evidence for separating plan-selection/early-stop behavior from the objective recipe; they should be read before any parameter is touched. This is advisory text only and authorizes no change.

No retained fact identifies a single controllable parameter responsible for the late-window speed and position error; changing holding_tip_speed_weight, terminal_tip_speed_weight or force limits now would be unfounded, and per-tendon tension samples inspected (updates 33 and 34, max 5.6612 N) show no 8.0 N saturation. Defer pending the retained-evidence reads above.

A single granted bounded check (prediction_braking at one retained saved projected state, or one-weight local_comparison) could measure local endpoint speed/position sensitivity, but it was deliberately not selected in this phase and a 10 ms projected-model horizon cannot by itself account for the 0.05 s settling window; the check should be scoped only after the unread retained records are consumed.

attribution.reason: The recipe sets holding_tip_speed_weight=0.0, terminal_tip_speed_weight=0.0 and holding_brake_lead_s=0.0 while a tip speed scale of 0.02 m/s exists; zero speed weights are consistent with a control law that does not penalize residual tip speed, but no cost-term contribution or closed-loop comparison was available to show that this produces the observed 0.05 s overshoot, so it is not established.

34 of 35 updates report User_Requested_Stop and deadline_misses=35, and the request describes update 0 as feasible_early_stop with optimization_nonconverged=true and feasible_suboptimal_update=true; stop/deadline-path accepted plans can be suboptimal, but optimization_selected_iteration and optimization_raw_status for updates 0..34 are retained and were not read, so the link to late-window speed is unverified.

In the two sampled updates (33 and 34) every applied tension is at or below 5.6612 N versus the 8.0 N per-tendon limit, so the two inspected samples show no saturation; 33 of 35 updates and the retained actual_tension_n series were not read, so saturation elsewhere cannot be ruled in or out.

The retained one-step predictions are implicit-Euler projected-model outputs (prediction_source=accepted_plan, substeps=1); the retained backend motion series (source.backend_motion) could not be read, so predicted versus measured late-window motion cannot be compared with the available tools.

regenerate_warm_states=true with numerical_source=bundled_guess means each solve starts from regenerated/guessed seeds rather than carried warm plans; without retained optimizer iteration traces (control_snapshots.json not retained) the effect of seed quality on accepted-plan quality cannot be measured.

Retained controller recipe declares holding_brake_lead_s=0.0, holding_tip_speed_weight=0.0, terminal_tip_speed_weight=0.0, tip_speed_scale_m_s=0.02, regenerate_warm_states=true and numerical_source=bundled_guess.
